messages:
Li: quick after-action from the eu-west failover earlier. main takeaways: fallback routing had no effective throttle, warm-standby saturated and increased restore time, and incremental backup verification didn't surface delayed deltas. Posting proposed actions + owners. please ack and update ETA inline.

Li: concise action list:
1) fallback throttle + per-region concurrency limit (owner: Carlos)
2) automated synthetic restores to validate backups (owner: Priya)
3) runbook: explicit KV prefix flush + pre-restore capacity probe (owner: Nikhil)
4) add circuit-breaker to routing mesh that trips on sustained error% or latency (owner: Carlos)
5) quarterly DR tabletop + monthly micro-dry-run for warm-standby (owner: Li)

Carlos: taking 1 & 4. I want to add per-region inflight cap (default 1000) and a fallback ramp-down window of 3m. Plan: draft patch to routing-mesh by Fri, unit tests + staging deploy next week. Proposed config snippet: 
```json
{"region_policy": {"eu-west-1": {"inflight_cap": 1000, "fallback_ramp_s": 180}, "fallback_circuit": {"error_pct": 0.1, "window_s": 120}}}
```

Priya: I'll handle synthetic restores. The incremental backup had a 9-11m divergence during the event; we need periodic restores to a test namespace. ETA: prototype job by Wed, integration into alerts by Fri. Example check (dry run):
```
# run synthetic restore to ns:test-restore
./backupctl restore --snapshot latest --target ns:test-restore --dry-run
```

Nikhil: Runbook updates for #3. I'll add commands to flush prefix KV caches, run warm-standby capacity probe (scale-to-check), and a rollback checklist. Draft by Thu. Q: do we want the runbook to include the admin CLI for forcing fallback? I can add a protected snippet with a required approval jump.

Li: include the admin CLI but gated by approval. add a clear WARN block in the runbook.

Carlos: small note: operator command to reduce fallback weight (emergency):
```
redwoodctl route set-weight --from eu-west-1 --to us-west-2 --weight 0.2 --reason "emergency"
```

Priya: adding alert logic: if snapshot_age > 6m OR apply_lag > 60s then page oncall + mark degraded. Also adding a nightly synthetic-restore success metric.

ops-bot: Reminder: micro-dry-run scheduled Tue 08:30 UTC (staging). RSVP with :heavy_check_mark:.

Li: need 2 operators + infra + oncall for Tue run. please RSVP.

Carlos: +1 available Tue 08:30 UTC

Priya: +1, will bring synthetic-restore job ready 30m prior

Nikhil: +1, will update runbook before the run and be standby

Li: timeline recap: Carlos (routing + circuit-breaker) PR by Fri, staging deploy next week; Priya synthetic restores prototype Wed, alerts by Fri; Nikhil runbook draft Thu; Li to schedule quarterly tabletop and publish invite. I'll add these to the remediation tracker and follow up weekly until closed.

Carlos: ack

Priya: ack

Nikhil: ack

Li: thanks all. after the micro-dry-run we'll have a 20m retro to capture any gaps and ship quick fixes. if anyone wants pre-read material ping me and I'll post runbook diffs here.
